text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka, Bourbon! Thanks for<n>celebrating my
birthday. ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
As a little something in return, I'm<n>gonna do an
impromptu birthday<n>concert right now! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Standing by for<n>Operation: Call and
Response.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You're joking... If we do a concert<n>here, a fuming
Air Groove will come<n>running at any second...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we call it off? We're fast,<n>but some
things even we can't run<n>from.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I guess... But an Umadol always<n>responds in kind to
the love she<n>receives.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Then how about we apply for<n>permission to use
the outdoor stage?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In doing so, we should be able to<n>enjoy your
birthday concert without<n>any trouble.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Good idea! All right, if we apply right<n>away, we
should get the OK by<n>tomorrow, right? No time to
waste! ☆

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...But then it won't be a "birthday"<n>concert anymore.
